reason:
Driven cold at 390 and 1440 on state=phone, desk, day, ended and unfurl. The one measured claim holds - the received surface has exactly one tab stop, the b-behindSummary fold, and eight Tab presses cycle between it and the body - but everything the finding builds on that is either false or an argument against the direction's own proposition.

FACTUALLY OVERSTATED. The guest is not left holding nothing: the day is the third thing on the surface, in full ('Saturday 3 October 2026' / 'Wedding day', directly under the 79-day count), repeated as 'Sat 3 Oct' on the measure row, and - contrary to the finding's closing line - the ended state does NOT stop at 'This link has ended': it renders 'The day is Saturday 3 October 2026. Ask Orla for a new link.' with the tense driven off the clock (render-b.js states.ended). The terminal surface was deliberately built to carry forward exactly the fact the finding says is withheld. The finding's own fix concedes the point ('Print keeps it as the typed date it already has'). So this is not a missing fact; it is a request for a transport mechanism, and it must be judged as a feature ask, not a defect.

THE FIX WOULD MAKE IT WORSE, and this is the ground I refuse it on. The received object's whole proposition is a living link - the unfurl states it in the sender's own words, 'Here is everything, love. It updates itself.' - and the owner surface exists to move dates ('Editing is moving something nearer', lock.md). A single-event .ics writes a frozen copy of the one date the product is built to change, into a place the product can never reach again. The day moves, and every guest's calendar is silently, confidently wrong, with no channel to correct it. That is the paid-for 'self-contradicting counts' class (lessons.md: every fact derives from ONE accessor; lock.md: 'Every number on every surface derives from one accessor in fixture.js') exported off-surface where it cannot be reconciled at all. For a wedding, handing 120 people a copy that can disagree with the plan is a strictly worse outcome than handing them a link that cannot.

AND IT IS NOT THE ONE-LINER IT CLAIMS. 'No new tokens' does not buy out the states: a browser download needs a success state, a failure state, an iOS Safari save-file detour, and explicit exclusion from print and ended - new states on a fourteen-state system that has none of them, argued in a single 13px line. That is a build, and it sits on the wrong side of the line the brief draws around the data model and product feature work.

Not the twice-refuted arrival-animation ask in another form - that one lost to the motion doctrine and this raises no motion. It fails on its own merits, not by association.

The residue worth naming for the log, and not worth a finding: the received chain's single tab stop is a stated property of the direction, not an oversight. A plan you are sent is a document. The moment it grows a verb it stops being the finished thing that was handed to you and becomes an app with one button in it, and the next round's findings are 'why not RSVP, why not directions, why not share'.
